description: This PHP file defines a class `default_formatter` that provides various methods for formatting, fetching templates, and handling configurations related to connectors in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes logic for determining template file paths and rendering formats for detail, list, and search views, and manages Smarty template engine integration.

classes.name: default_formatter
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering various formats (detail, list, search) in connectors, utilizing Smarty templates and dynamic template path resolution based on source class names and module context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the default_formatter class, currently empty.

methods.name: getDetailViewFormat
methods.description: Returns the formatted detail view content by selecting appropriate Smarty templates based on source class and module.

methods.name: getEditViewFormat
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for edit view formatting.

methods.name: getListViewFormat
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for list view formatting.

methods.name: getSearchFormFormat
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for search form formatting.

methods.name: fetchSmarty
methods.description: Helper method to fetch the Smarty template content, similar to getDetailViewFormat but with default fallback templates.

methods.name: getSourceMapping
methods.description: Returns the source mapping configuration from the component's source.

methods.name: setSmarty
methods.description: Sets the Smarty template engine object.

methods.name: getSmarty
methods.description: Returns the current Smarty template engine object.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Assigns the component object to the formatter.

methods.name: getTplFileName
methods.description: Gets the current template file name.

methods.name: getIconFilePath
methods.description: Returns an empty string; placeholder for icon path retrieval.
